integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite independent-arithmetic and numerical corroboration supplied; no independent mathematical validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Real unweighted finite stars, m>=2, 1<p<infinity; complete-pair Gini seminorm. No claim for weighted graphs, higher dimensions or game-theoretic p-Laplacians. Non-Hilbert sharpness is asymptotic along infinitesimal perturbations.
title: A three-regime Gini stability law for real graph \(p\)-harmonic centers
